folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B220, 2026-11-04
folds.body:
All F1–F9, B1–B21, nine illustrative records, T1–T10, S1–S12 and P1–P9 were reviewed. Preserve the original corrections instead of reverting to initial absence claims: combat already has fighter arrays; singleton publication/routing is the relevant gap, and main_character tags differ from hero_id. Tern already blocks ordinary travel through its existing native action route, while authorized restore/realm relocation has different semantics. Human native scaffold can coexist with physical reedling. The heir function transfers estate into a supplied envelope and does not itself construct a human body. Historical source/test locators are not a fresh current census (AD32/AD36).

The proposed full nested-body schema, fork3, simulation7/body-only mode and later bodies registry are one unselected compatibility design. B218’s Nov3 supplement instead proposes a derived legacy native bodyBinding with no migration for that read. These are different scopes, not two simultaneous authorities: select the smallest actual consumer contract, then allocate any version from current constants. No new body schema, service enrollment, global fork bump or N-body migration is required merely because this specification exists. A no-body controller, aggregate brood view and material body record remain distinct; their illustrative common notation is not proof all pass the same body validator.

Protect the physical/economic boundaries if a migration is actually selected: explicit nonhuman form outranks cosmetic race; parked reedling homeBody is not the currently controlled clay body; active Tern host lacks its own duplicate body because that same record moved; spent clay reserve stays spent; body title/control does not move goods, source ownership, method knowledge or XP. Missing-body compatibility applies only to a proven legacy scaffold, not every unknown modern actor. Unknown inert fields preserve information without becoming executable functions. Mixed-start all-form admission is a historical inspected limitation to reproduce against the current selected-start path before changing it.

Source functions and actual means remain distinct from method mastery, literacy, taught language, permission, item custody and world/material admission. Function queries should not silently delete every form restriction or convert a carried sentient blade into a humanoid rider. Ordinary NPC and player mechanisms can share a resolver while actor detail, channels and supported anatomy differ. Nonhuman practical play needs a real useful loop and receiving action; hiding human buttons or registering a template does not supply it. Proposed readonly APIs are not existing callable exports.

B20’s missing dedicated tests was a bounded Oct14 search, and even this report labels browser/historical evidence unknown; B220 does not renew that absence or infer the tests are still missing. Keep full-envelope old/new content and failed-publication checks for actual persistent changes, with post-durable display failure distinguished from abort before durability as in B170/B203. Current AD51 qualifies example-count gates, AD42 makes human review optional, and current desktop/prose-first targets replace1366-primary. Current broader scope retires any old first-world/prestige gate. No runtime, migration, test, build, browser, save or import was executed here.
